description: Public catalog difficulty label for a content unit: text level and zone only. Does not expose E_diff module scores, weight profiles, or per-level curves — those live in spec-server's private content_rating cache. See docs/lexicon-public-private-audit.md.

textLevel.description: User-agnostic SPEC text level band for this content.

zoneAtLevel.description: Zone classification at textLevel for a default reference profile.

contentRatingRef.description: Optional opaque reference to the private tools.spec.private.content.contentRating record (spec-server) that this public band was derived from. Lets spec-server correlate the public label with the full E_diff module vector without exposing it. Outside consumers cannot dereference it. refType SHOULD be 'contentRating'. See RECORD_REFERENCE_HIERARCHY.md S2.
